title: Subfield scalar extension preserves local presentations after raw scheme pullback
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E\le F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$, let $X,Z$ be schemes, and let $f:Z	o X$ be any morphism. Write $E_W,F_W$ for the pulled-back coefficient rings on a scheme $W$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and $G_W=\operatorname{Ext}_{E_W	o F_W}=F_W\otimes_{E_W}-$ for extension along the coefficient inclusion [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map, sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. For a sheaf of rings $R$ on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$, let $f^
atural_R=\operatorname{mapMod}(f^{-1})$ denote raw pullback of internal modules to modules over $f^{-1}R$ [def-sfb-finite-upper-star, def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal, sk-def-sfb-transport, sk-def-sfb-module-objects].

Let $M$ be an $E_X$-module object. If the $f^{-1}E_X$-module $f^
atural_{E_X}M$ is locally finitely presented [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented], then the $f^{-1}F_X$-module $f^
atural_{F_X}(G_XM)$ is locally finitely presented. More precisely, every pro-étale covering family $\{u_i:U_i	o Z\}$ that witnesses the former local finite presentation also witnesses the latter. There is no restriction on $f$ and no quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness or Noetherian hypothesis on $X$ or $Z$.
